purpose: Walk your own farm and record where each of the five routes shows up. Your notes become the first section of your farm food safety plan in Module 04.

items: Pick your example crop from topic 1.1.
Walk the path that crop takes, from field to the point of sale.
At each stop, write down which of the five routes could reach the crop there.
Rate each risk as low, medium, or high, with one sentence of reasoning.
Keep your notes. You will paste them into your farm plan in Module 04.

blocks.caption: Farm walk notes for a sample lettuce crop
rows: Deer tracks and an unprotected creek used for irrigation
Family helpers harvest; bins are rinsed but not sanitized
Wooden table, hard to sanitize, cats in the barn

items.summary: Compare your notes with a model answer
body: A strong set of notes names at least four stops, links each to a specific route, and gives a reason for each rating that points to something you saw. If you rated everything low, walk the farm again and look at water sources and animal signs first; they are the most often missed.

blocks.label: This activity is not graded
text: Your notes feed the graded farm plan in Module 04. The Module 01 quiz is in Brightspace Quizzes.
